mapper.select: SELECT AreaID FROM NetNode WHERE ID=#{nodeID}
SELECT NodeName FROM NetNode WHERE ID=#{nodeID}
SELECT NodeUse FROM NetNode WHERE ID=#{nodeID}

SELECT ID, SensorName, GroupID, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, SensorUse, SensorUnit, SensorRemark, LimitType, LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, LimitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd FROM SensorCode WHERE SensorUse=1 AND ID=#{sensorCodeID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NetNode (ID , NodeName, NodePosX, NodePosY, RegDate, NodeAddr, NodeUse, NodeDataTable, NodeLastTable, AreaID, HomePage) VALUES (#{nodeID},#{nodeName},#{nodePosX},#{nodePosY},#{timeStamp},#{area},1,#{dataNetRaw},#{dataNetLast},#{areaID},#{homePage})

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(ID),0)+1 FROM Sensor
INSERT INTO Sensor (ID, NodeID, SensorName, SensorCode, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, SensorUse, LimitType , LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, LimitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd, SensorUnit, SensorRemark) VALUES (#{id},#{nodeID},#{SensorCode.Name},#{materialCode}, #{SensorCode.LimitNotice},#{SensorCode.LimitAttention}, #{SensorCode.LimitWarning}, #{SensorCode.LimitValueLaw},1,#{SensorCode.LimitType},#{SensorCode.LimitNoticeBegin},#{SensorCode.LimitNoticeEnd}, #{SensorCode.LimitAttentionBegin}, #{SensorCode.LimitAttentionEnd},#{SensorCode.LimitWarningBegin},#{SensorCode.LimitWarningEnd},#{SensorCode.LimitValueLawBegin},#{SensorCode.LimitValueLawEnd}, #{SensorCode.Unit},#{SensorCode.Remark})
